name: Quick Quiz
description: Multiple-choice questions, one at a time, with a kind explanation after each answer. Install a quiz pack to fill it.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: A short multiple-choice quiz, one question at a time. The questions come from a quiz pack.
help.goal: Just for fun. Answer what you like; your score is shown privately at the end and is not kept.
howToPlay: Read the question and choose an answer.
You will see the right answer and a short explanation.
Press Next question to carry on.
At the end you see your score. Press Play again for a fresh shuffle.

controls.action: Choose the focused answer or press the focused button
Reach Next question or Play again

tips: Your place is saved, so you can stop after any question.
A wrong answer is just a chance to learn something.
